name: 20_tier3_trueup
description: Tier-3 (attestor) series with annual true-ups. S1: four quarterly estimates paid for 2026, a +400 true-up recorded with trueup_nonce 0 (a replay of the same signature and a signature over the wrong nonce fail InvalidAttestorSignature; a second true-up while one is unpaid is TrueUpOutstanding), paid inside the 60-day window without accrual; for 2027 a +1,000 true-up is left unpaid past the deadline → Late (releases blocked, redeem rejected), then paid with 10 days of accrual and the series recovers. S2: a −800 adjustment bounded by the year's accepted payments (−7,000 is TrueUpAdjustmentTooLarge) becomes router credit consumed by the next report.

config.chainDomainNote: Bid/ask commitments, signed messages and the deployment domain depend on chain-specific wallet bytes and chain id; harnesses recompute them from the plaintext fields here (salts, prices, quantities, periods, nonces, prior/income commitments, liquidity flags) and sign with the keys derived from `keys[*].seed`. Amounts, periods and ledger values are chain-independent.

S2: all four tranches

routerCredit 800; trueupNonce 1; lastTrueupYear 2026; nothing due

signed over nonce 1 while the series' trueup_nonce is 0

replay of the same signature: the stored nonce is now 1
the previous true-up must be paid first

42 unpaused days < 60 → no accrual; vault_receive_gross(400, Payment, period_of(attested_at))

releases resume: tranches 3 and 4 (21,000)
recovery: a normal estimate for Q1 2028
S1 gross: 6,800 + 400 + 7,200 + 1,002.19178 + 400; releasedTotal == proceeds; vault empty
S2 gross: 6,800 + 800 (the credit covered 800 of the 1,600 Q1 2027 payment)
